lessons.title: 8. Relational JOINs
lessons.description: Join customers and orders on customers.id = orders.customer_id to select customer name and total_amount.
lessons.starter_code:
-- TODO: pair each customer with the total_amount of each of their orders
SELECT c.name, o.total_amount FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON 0;
lessons.solution_code: SELECT c.name, o.total_amount FROM customers c INNER JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id;

source.name: SQLite official documentation (sqlite.org) — SELECT — join operators including INNER/CROSS JOIN

learning_objectives: Combine rows from two tables with INNER JOIN ... ON
Use table aliases to keep join queries readable
